lines.en: label day281:
scene nodokaoffice1
I lean back in my office chair and wait for Nodoka to arrive.
lines.zh: 我往办公椅背上一靠，等着 Nodoka 过来。

lines.en: Today is the day that she’s supposed to be briefing me on whatever her “mission” is and, suffice it to say, I’m a little on edge.
lines.zh: 今天是她要向我简报她那个「任务」的日子，说句实话，我有点坐立不安。

lines.en: My whole approach to teaching has been just leaving everyone alone, so the thought that I might need to make special accommodations for someone new is...
lines.zh: 我教学的全部方针就是别管任何人，所以一想到我可能得为某个新来的人做特殊安排，那就……

lines.en: Well, not a thing I want to do.
lines.zh: 嗯，那可不是我想干的事。

lines.en: But if that’s the price that must be paid to get another cute (And apparently very smart) girl into the class...I guess I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: 不过如果这就是为了让又一个可爱（而且显然非常聪明）的女孩进班所必须付出的代价……我想我会看看能怎么办。

lines.en: Or, I could completely luck out and her final condition could just be sleeping with her or something.
lines.zh: 或者，我也可以撞个大运，她的最终条件就只是跟她睡一觉什么的。

lines.en: It wouldn’t be the first time something like that has been offered up during an initial office visit.
lines.zh: 这种事在初次办公室会面时被提出来，也不是第一次了。

lines.en: Thanks again, Kirin.
lines.zh: 再次感谢你，Kirin。

lines.en: : Helloooo? Sensei?
lines.zh: : 有人吗——？Sensei？

lines.en: : May I come in?
lines.zh: : 我可以进来吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And I accept.
lines.zh: : 可以。而且我接受。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice2
: Oh?
: And what are you accepting exactly?
lines.zh: : 你具体是接受了什么？

lines.en: : I spoke preemptively. I imagined a final condition in my head and I’m pretty sure I got it wrong.
lines.zh: : 我说得太早了。我脑子里想象了一个最终条件，而我相当确定我想错了。

lines.en: : Please, do tell what it is that you imagined.
lines.zh: : 拜托，说说看你想象的是什么。

lines.en: : I probably shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 我大概不该说。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice3
: You don’t need to. The fact that you’re unwilling to tell me means that it’s likely something sexual in nature, to which I must refuse.
lines.zh: : 你不用说了。你不敢告诉我这一点本身就说明，那大概是某种性方面的东西，而我必须拒绝。

lines.en: : Well then what do you want, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那你到底想要什么？

lines.en: : Right down to brass tacks, then? No small talk?
lines.zh: : 那就单刀直入咯？不寒暄了？

lines.en: : I figured it might be good to get to know each other a little better before informing you of my plan.
lines.zh: : 我本来觉得，在告诉你我的计划之前，我们先稍微熟悉一下会更好。

lines.en: : Well, what sort of things do you want to know?
lines.zh: : 那你想知道哪方面的事？

lines.en: : If it’s my age, I’m delighted to inform you that I know it now.
lines.zh: : 如果是年龄的话，我很高兴地通知你，我现在知道了。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Sensei. I’m very proud of you.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Sensei。我为你感到非常骄傲。

lines.en: : But no. I need to know how far you’re willing to go for not only my livelihood, but that of my friends as well.
lines.zh: : 但不是。我需要知道，你愿意为了我——以及我朋友们——的生活，做到什么程度。

lines.en: : You’re not asking me to kill someone, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会是要我去杀什么人吧？

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice4
: No. But...if you’re offering, I think it’s safe to assume that you’re willing to go plenty far.
lines.zh: : 不是。不过……如果你主动提出来的话，我想可以放心地认为你愿意走得相当远。

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我没有。

lines.en: : Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 确定。

lines.en: : Well, I suppose what I had in mind is easier anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯，反正我心里想的那个办法本来就更容易些。

lines.en: : What is it, then? And why should I have to go out on a limb for you despite you not really bringing anything other than high grades and perversion to the table?
lines.zh: : 那是什么？再说了，除了高分和变态之外你也没带来什么，我凭什么要为你豁出去？

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice5
: Who says that is all I have to bring to the table?
lines.zh: : 谁说我拿得出手的就只有这些？

lines.en: : I come to you today with a proposition, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我今天带来了一个提议。

lines.en: : A chance to turn multiple lives around {i}and{/i} improve the state of our class all through one menial task.
lines.zh: : 一个机会——只要完成一件微不足道的小事，就能扭转好几个人的人生，{i}还{/i}能改善我们班的状况。

lines.en: : How menial?
lines.zh: : 有多微不足道？

lines.en: : Kidnapping.
lines.zh: : 绑架。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice6
: No?
lines.zh: : 不行？

lines.en: : Did you think I was just going to agree to kidnapping someone?
lines.zh: : 你以为我会随口就答应去绑架什么人吗？

lines.en: : I thought you’d at least {i}think{/i} about it.
lines.zh: : 我{i}以为{/i}你至少会考虑一下。

lines.en: : What? No. How would kidnapping someone help improve the state of our class in the first place?
lines.zh: : 什么？不行。再说了，绑架一个人到底怎么能改善我们班的状况？

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice7
: By turning it into something much more than {i}just{/i} a class.
lines.zh: : 通过把它变成一个{i}远不止是{/i}班级的东西。

lines.en: : By turning it into a {i}paradise...{/i}
lines.zh: : 把它变成一个{i}乐园……{/i}

lines.en: : Okay, listen. You haven’t transferred in yet, but I’ll let you know now that our class isn’t exactly a {i}normal{/i} class.
lines.zh: : 好吧，听着。你还没转进来，不过我现在就告诉你，我们这个班可不算是{i}正常{/i}的班。

lines.en: : I’m aware. I heard all the details from Futaba.
lines.zh: : 我知道。Futaba 把细节都跟我说了。

lines.en: : In fact, if it weren’t for the information I received from her, I never would have come up with this idea in the first place.
lines.zh: : 事实上，如果不是从她那儿得到的信息，我根本不会想出这个主意。

lines.en: : You’re going to have to explain a little better than that.
lines.zh: : 你得解释得再清楚一点。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice8
: No. I will not.
lines.zh: : 不。我不会解释的。

lines.en: : Then I won’t do whatever it is-
lines.zh: : 那我就不会去做那件什么——

lines.en: : Because I will allow my beautiful assistant to do the explaining for me.
lines.zh: : 因为我会让我美丽的助手来替我解释。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Come! You may now enter!
lines.zh: : 进来吧！你现在可以进来了！

lines.en: : Nodoka, who is-
lines.zh: : Nodoka，谁是——

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice9
The door opens and...in walks a peculiar combination of girls.
lines.zh: 门开了，然后……走进来的是一群组合相当奇特的女生。

lines.en: : What is going on right now?
lines.zh: : 现在到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Dreams! Dreams are going on! Lots of them!
lines.zh: : 梦想！现在正在发生的是梦想！好多好多梦想！

lines.en: : Noriko, do you have any idea what Rin means by this?
lines.zh: : Noriko，你知道 Rin 这话是什么意思吗？

lines.en: : And wait, since when do you two even talk to each other?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们俩又是什么时候开始说话的？

lines.en: : Since a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 几分钟前。

lines.en: : I’m not supposed to be here, but I came to see what you were doing and she was just...standing in the hall looking all determined and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我本来不该在这儿，不过我是来看看你在干嘛的，然后她就……站在走廊里，一脸特别坚定什么的。

lines.en: : Determination! Dreams!
lines.zh: : 坚定！梦想！

lines.en: : Yes, Rin. I understand.
lines.zh: : 好的，Rin。我明白了。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice10
: Noriko? This is the class you transferred into after Miss Watabe’s?
lines.zh: : Noriko？你从 Watabe 老师班上转出来之后进的就是这个班？

lines.en: : I was certain they were just kicking you out of[school].
lines.zh: : 我还以为他们是把你直接踢出[school]了呢。

lines.en: : Nope! Just putting me back where I belong!
lines.zh: : 才不是！只是把我放回我该在的地方！

lines.en: : Have you already been notified of what’s going on right now?
lines.zh: : 你已经知道现在在发生什么事了吗？

lines.en: : More or less. I know Otoha is involved and that’s enough to count me in.
lines.zh: : 大体上知道。我知道有 Otoha 的份，光凭这一点我就算加入了。

lines.en: : Otoha? The musician girl?
lines.zh: : Otoha？那个搞音乐的女孩？

lines.en: Well that certainly explains why Rin looks like...that.
lines.zh: 这倒确实解释了 Rin 为什么是那副……样子。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice11
: Precisely.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : I want you to kidnap Otoha Okakura, ensure that she winds up in your class, and convert the[school] into the ultimate yuritopia.
lines.zh: : 我要你去绑架 Otoha Okakura，确保她最终进了你的班，然后把这所[school]改造成终极的百合乌托邦。

lines.en: : Yuritopia!
lines.zh: : 百合乌托邦！

lines.en: : I get why Rin would want that, but why would you make something like this a condition?
lines.zh: : 我明白 Rin 为什么会想要这个，可你为什么要把这种事当成条件？

lines.en: : Aren’t you going to ask me how I know Otoha?
lines.zh: : 你不问问我是怎么认识 Otoha 的吗？

lines.en: : I just assumed it was through your sister.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为是通过你姐姐认识的。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice12
: Nope! We used to be in a band together.
lines.zh: : 才不是！我们以前组过乐队。

lines.en: : Cool, right?
lines.zh: : 很酷吧？

lines.en: : Yuritopia!
lines.zh: : 百合乌托邦！

lines.en: : To get back on track, the reason that I’m making this a “condition” is that I’ve been quite worried about Otoha’s well-being lately.
lines.zh: : 言归正传，我把这件事列为「条件」的原因是，我最近相当担心 Otoha 的状态。

lines.en: : She doesn’t fare well being cooped up in her house with overbearing parents all day so, as her friend, rescuing her is currently my top priority.
lines.zh: : 她整天和管得特别严的父母一起关在家里，状态很不好，所以作为她的朋友，拯救她目前是我的头等大事。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice13
: Yeah. Yuri stuff aside, Otoha’s seemed really drained lately.
lines.zh: : 是啊。百合的事先放一边，Otoha 最近看起来真的特别疲惫。

lines.en: : And I’ve already been talking to her about transferring over for a while...but she’s still on the fence for some reason.
lines.zh: : 而且我已经跟她说了好一阵子转学的事……可她不知为什么还在犹豫。

lines.en: : I figure that if we could make sure she winds up in our class, though, she’ll definitely do it.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，如果我们能确保她最终进我们班，她就一定会转。

lines.en: : And since her and Nodoka are friends already, the two of them could room together.
lines.zh: : 而且她和 Nodoka 已经是朋友了，她们俩可以住一间。

lines.en: : The groundwork has already been laid, Sensei. It now falls on you to ensure the rest of the building is built.
lines.zh: : 地基已经打好了，Sensei。剩下的建筑部分，现在就落在你身上了。

lines.en: : Why {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 为什么是{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: : What can I do that you guys can’t?
lines.zh: : 有什么是你们做不到、而我做得到的？

lines.en: : I’ve barely even talked to Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我跟 Otoha 几乎没说过话。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice14
: Absolutely nothing!
lines.zh: : 什么都没有！

lines.en: : Why do you look so proud in saying that?
lines.zh: : 你说这话的时候为什么一脸得意？

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice15
: Because the solution is quite simple.
lines.zh: : 因为解决办法相当简单。

lines.en: : I believe the main reason that Otoha is afraid of transferring[school]s is because she can’t guarantee her grades will remain high enough to spend her free time as she pleases.
lines.zh: : 我认为 Otoha 害怕转[school]的主要原因，是她没法保证自己的成绩能一直高到让她随意支配空闲时间。

lines.en: : The transition to homeschooling has already negatively impacted her GPA, and she is now on the cusp of having to retire as a musician until she is out of [high_school].
lines.zh: : 转入家庭教育已经对她的平均绩点造成了负面影响，而她现在正处于一个临界点——在[high_school]毕业之前，她可能不得不退出乐坛。

lines.en: : As a fellow prodigy and the ultimate friend, I refuse to let talent like hers go to waste.
lines.zh: : 作为同为天才的人，以及最够格的朋友，我拒绝让像她那样的才华白白浪费。

lines.en: : So where {i}you{/i} come in is ensuring her that her grades will remain safe and secure in this new environment.
lines.zh: : 所以{i}你{/i}发挥作用的地方，就是向她保证，在这个新环境里她的成绩会万无一失。

lines.en: : Also, I need reference material for something I’m writing and want to closely study any potential relationship (Or lack thereof) including her and my new assistant here.
lines.zh: : 另外，我正在写的东西需要参考资料，我想近距离研究一下她和我这位新助手之间任何可能的（或者根本不存在的）恋爱关系。

lines.en: : This isn’t exactly “kidnapping,” Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 这算不上「绑架」吧，Nodoka。

lines.en: : If she vehemently refuses to comply, I am not against binding her and tossing her into the back of your car.
lines.zh: : 如果她激烈拒绝配合，我也不反对把她绑起来扔进你车的后座。

lines.en: : I don’t have a car.
lines.zh: : 我没有车。

lines.en: : Well then we should hope Plan A succeeds so you don’t need to obtain one.
lines.zh: : 那我们就该指望 A 计划成功，这样你就不用去弄一辆了。

lines.en: : And I take it that you two are in complete agreement with all aspects of this plan?
lines.zh: : 那么我猜你们两位对这计划的方方面面都完全同意？

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice16
: I like Plan B more. But yeah, it would be cool to have Otoha around again. She’s super chill.
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢 B 计划。不过是啊，能让 Otoha 再回到身边也挺酷的。她超级随和。

lines.en: : I like both plans, but I’m pretty sure you already know that by now.
lines.zh: : 两个计划我都喜欢，不过我猜你早就知道了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t know why I included you at all.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我都不知道干嘛要把你也算进来。

lines.en: : Is it settled, then? You’ll accompany us on an excursion to steal her?
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了？你会陪我们走一趟，把她偷过来？

lines.en: : Wait, I actually have to {i}go{/i} somewhere?
lines.zh: : 等等，我还真得{i}出门{/i}？

lines.en: : Futaba informed me that your affinity for cute girls is the only reason you travel in the first place, so I figured it would be fine.
lines.zh: : Futaba 告诉我，你对可爱女孩的偏好是你出行的唯一理由，所以我想应该没问题。

lines.en: : It is. I’m just obligated to complain about things that require me exerting any amount of effort.
lines.zh: : 是没问题。只是我但凡要花一点力气的事，我就有义务抱怨两句。

lines.en: : Want me to just go tie her up and bring her here in your place?
lines.zh: : 要不我替你去把她绑了带过来？

lines.en: : I can probably borrow one of the 567 cars.
lines.zh: : 我大概能借到 567 的一辆车。

lines.en: : I don’t know how to drive yet, but I’m sure I’m smart enough to figure it out.
lines.zh: : 我还不会开车，不过我肯定够聪明，能琢磨明白。

lines.en: : When is this trip exactly?
lines.zh: : 这趟出门确切是什么时候？

lines.en: : Does tomorrow work for you? Otoha has free time after her lessons on Wednesday that she usually spends in a park near our old[school].
lines.zh: : 明天你方便吗？Otoha 星期三上完课之后有空，她通常会去我们以前那所[school]附近的公园。

lines.en: : Nodoka and I already planned on going to see her, but if you came too I’m sure we could get her to agree to at least try it out.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 和我本来就打算去看她，不过如果你也来，我肯定我们能让她至少答应试一试。

lines.en: : Again, the trick is to really just hammer in that her grades won’t be an issue.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，关键就是反复给她灌输——她的成绩不会有问题。

lines.en: : I feel like you three are really taking advantage of how horrible of a teacher I am right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你们三个是在充分利用我这老师当得有多烂。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice17
: Hey, don’t call yourself horrible. You’re just going through some stuff right now.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别说自己烂。你只是现在正在经历一些事而已。

lines.en: : You’ve helped me a lot, remember?
lines.zh: : 你帮了我很多，记得吗？

lines.en: : You’ve helped me a lot too, but like...I don’t know if I’d really call you a “good” teacher or whatever.
lines.zh: : 你也帮了我很多，不过呢……我不知道我会不会真的叫你一声「好」老师什么的。

lines.en: : I honestly don’t care. I only come here out of obligation. I’ve already been pre-accepted to the college of my choice.
lines.zh: : 说实话我不在乎。我来这儿只是出于义务。我已经被我选中的大学提前录取了。

lines.en: Have fun {i}getting{/i} there, though.
lines.zh: 不过，祝你们{i}走到{/i}那一步的过程愉快吧。

lines.en: : Sure, I’ll come with you tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 行，我明天跟你们去。

lines.en: : There are no hidden caveats to any of this, though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过这一切都没有什么隐藏的附加条件，对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t want to agree to taking in Otoha as well only to find that I’m going to need to like, pay for her phone bill or something.
lines.zh: : 我可不想刚答应也收下 Otoha，结果发现我还得给她交什么手机费之类的。

lines.en: : My plan maxes out at five lines and I’m already there.
lines.zh: : 我的套餐最多五条线，而我已经满了。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice18
: Why are you paying for five phone lines?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要付五条电话线的钱？

lines.en: : Did you figure out a way to clone Ami?
lines.zh: : 你想出克隆 Ami 的办法了吗？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 别管这个。

lines.en: : Me or Rin? Because we had two very different questions and I would like my own Ami clone if that's okay with you.
lines.zh: : 是回答我还是回答 Rin？因为我们问了两个完全不同的问题，而且如果可以的话，我也想要一个属于我自己的 Ami 克隆体。

lines.en: : Both of you...
lines.zh: : 你们两个……

lines.en: : There are no hidden caveats, but I do urge you to consider just how happy it would make all three of us if you were to agree.
lines.zh: : 没有隐藏的附加条件，不过我确实恳请你想一想，如果你答应了，我们三个会有多开心。

lines.en: : Also, you will be cordially invited to our first joint slumber party as a reward for your cooperation.
lines.zh: : 另外，作为对你配合的奖励，我们将诚挚邀请你参加我们的第一次联合睡衣派对。

lines.en: : Say no more. I’m in.
lines.zh: : 别说了。我加入。

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice19
: YURITOPIA!
lines.zh: : 百合乌托邦！

lines.en: : The promised land awaits, dear assistant.
lines.zh: : 应许之地在等着我们，亲爱的助手。

lines.en: : Hell yeah! Cute girls making out!
lines.zh: : 太他妈对了！可爱的女孩子亲亲！

lines.en: : Tentatively!
lines.zh: : 暂且！

lines.en: : I’ll probably find a way to ruin it!
lines.zh: : 我大概会想办法把这事搞砸的！

lines.en: : You know, I’ve seen some strange things in here, but this is probably among the strangest.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我在这里见过不少怪事，但这大概是其中最怪的之一。

lines.en: : Shhhhh...read the room. We’re having a moment right now.
lines.zh: : 嘘……看看气氛。我们正在进入状态呢。

lines.en: : But it’s...{i}my{/i} room.
lines.zh: : 可这是……{i}我的{/i}房间。

lines.en: : Shut up, Sensei! You know you like it!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Sensei！你明明就很享受！

lines.en: scene black
The three of them proceed to celebrate without my inclusion for the next five minutes or so before Nodoka calls on the group to disperse.
lines.zh: 接下来的五分钟左右，她们三个就这么自顾自地庆祝起来，完全没带上我，直到 Nodoka 招呼大家解散。

lines.en: Noriko has work today and Rin has plans with Futaba, so the two of them wind up leaving as soon as the call is made.
lines.zh: Noriko 今天要上班，Rin 和 Futaba 有约，所以解散令一下，她们俩就走了。

lines.en: Nodoka, on the other hand, feels the need to stay behind for some reason...
lines.zh: 而 Nodoka 不知为何觉得有必要留下来……

lines.en: scene nodokaoffice20
: You did a good thing today, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你今天做了件好事，Sensei。

lines.en: : There’s more to you than just rants about manipulation and impure thoughts, isn’t there?
lines.zh: : 你除了那些关于操纵的长篇大论和龌龊念头之外，还有别的东西，对吧？

lines.en: : Not much else, but yeah. I can do something nice every once in a while, I guess.
lines.zh: : 也没多少别的，不过是啊。我想我偶尔还是能干点好事的。

lines.en: : Well it earned you a handful of Nodoka points. Good job.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这为你赚到了一把 Nodoka 点数。干得不错。

lines.en: : Nodoka points?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 点数？

lines.en: : The Nodoka currency. You can use them to redeem Nodoka rewards.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 货币。你可以用它们来兑换 Nodoka 奖励。

lines.en: : How many do I have?
lines.zh: : 我有多少？

lines.en: : Five. But I won't be stingy in handing them out, so I'm sure you'll be rolling in them before you know it.
lines.zh: : 五个。不过我不会小气地发放，所以我相信你很快就会被它们淹没的。

lines.en: : Is there any reward I can buy with five points?
lines.zh: : 五个点数能买到什么奖励吗？

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to save them up for something better?
lines.zh: : 你确定不攒着换更好的东西吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even know what the rewards are yet.
lines.zh: : 我都还不知道奖励是什么。

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s better that you don’t.
lines.zh: : 也许你不知道会更好。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene nodokaoffice21
: See you tomorrow, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 明天见，Sensei~

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka leaves the room and I am suddenly alone with nothing but my Nodoka points.
lines.zh: Nodoka 离开了房间，我突然就只剩下孤零零一个人和我的 Nodoka 点数了。

lines.en: I didn’t think I’d be earning any imaginary currency during today’s visit, but I also didn’t plan on agreeing to “kidnap” the girl Rin has a crush on either...
lines.zh: 我没想过今天的会面会让我赚到什么虚构货币，可我也没打算答应去「绑架」Rin 暗恋的那个女孩……

lines.en: So I guess today was all sorts of weird.
lines.zh: 所以我想今天算是怪得五花八门了。

lines.en: But that’s just how things are now, I guess.
lines.zh: 不过现在的事情就是这样了，我想。

lines.en: And with the class on the brink of being entirely full-
lines.zh: 而随着这个班眼看就要彻底满员——

lines.en: I’m sure things will only get weirder...
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，事情只会变得更怪……
